steps.name: Vanguard Operator
steps.text: Ugh...

steps.name: Vanguard Operator
steps.text: Huh? Wh- what happened...?

steps.name: Vanguard Operator
steps.text: What am I doing here... why am I laying here...?

steps.name: Vanguard Operator
steps.text: I remember! We were infiltrating Chernobog to rescue Dr. {@nickname}——

steps.name: Vanguard Operator
steps.text: Boss! No, no, the boss, he...

steps.name: Vanguard Operator
steps.text: ...Boss...

steps.name: Vanguard Operator
steps.text: Huh? What's this paper?

steps.name: Vanguard Operator
steps.text: Hold up, this... It's Rhodes Island engineering stationary.

steps.name: Vanguard Operator
steps.text: Who could've left it here? What the hell happened?

steps.name: Vanguard Operator
steps.text: Woah, that's a lot of big words, and they're all over the place...
Operator whose name I do not know, hide yourself well. I had no opportunity to check your nameplate, nor do I remember your name.
Please pardon the hastily scrawled nature of this message, as I am wanting for time. Do me the favor of reading to the end.
First, do not fret. You are safe, for the moment.
However, you must not, under any circumstances, leave these ruins. The probability of the enemy spotting you before nightfall is quite high.
To put it simply, you are at present completely surrounded by the enemy.

steps.name: Vanguard Operator
steps.text: This isn't the boss's handwriting... did it even come from Rhodes Island?

steps.name: Vanguard Operator
steps.text: They sure wrote a lot. Why didn't they just wake me up and tell me——
You came.

steps.name: Vanguard Operator
steps.text: (Huh? A voice? Is it Reunion? Shit!)

steps.name: Vanguard Operator
steps.text: (...No, wait, it sounds familiar. It's that guy from the clinic——)

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: You have managed to completely paralyze Chernobog. I am not sure whether I should be congratulating you.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: We have both contracted Oripathy.
It truly is you.
I thought. It was just rumors.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: It's been years, Buldrokkas'tee.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: Or is it 'Patriot' now?

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: So. You remember me.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: ...General.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: Were it not for you charging so boldly into the fortress with that shield of yours, Barclay, Semyon, and I would surely have died at the hands of Kazimierz's Silverlance, Pegasus Order of Knighthood.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: My warriors. Are brave. Do not fear sacrifice.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: Hm. Your manner of speech is quite different now than it was years ago.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: I once witnessed you rousing the troops with your rhetoric, driving even Barclay the Bald Butcher to cheer your name. No easy feat.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: The infection. Changed my vocal cords. Now. It is difficult. For me to speak. Fluently. Ridiculous.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: As is this identity you have constructed.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: Oh?

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: So, the Northern Tundra Guerrillas... that was you leading them. I never would have imagined you could be running around with dozens of Wendigos.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: That cavalry commander, Alyosha Bluebeard, he made a bet with me that you would become Grand Marshal of the Ursus Army.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: Just staff captain, General. Times have changed.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: ...I was jesting. But your loyalty, your record, and the plans you would devise in our staff meetings... You truly were one of the finest officers in all of Ursus.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: You go too far. I am Sarkaz, after all.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: If someone like you couldn't become colonel, the entire Ursus High Command should have been court-martialed.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: Of course, most of them are long dead.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: Then, I have outlasted them. Your colleagues, are mostly dead.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: And, His Majesty said, the army serves the country. Not their careers.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: He also once said it is not blood that binds the Ursus people together, but conviction. What of that now? I can only hope His Majesty is ready to rest in peace.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: All our recent Emperors have seen you as nothing more than monsters. You are not Ursus warriors to them. They have done everything they can to oppress your people.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: That one, more enlightened Emperor. Has already passed. This, I understand.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: The war beasts. Of Ursus. Could drown the world, with their numbers. I am not special.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: Then it is not because of the Army that you left.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: Correct. I do not care. I want only to stand, shoulder to shoulder. With my warriors.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: General, sit. Drink, with me. I have some. From the north.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: ...Time grows short. Let us save it for next time.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: Oh... Very well.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: No matter.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: Go to 4th street. Find survivors. Do not threaten them. Minimize casualties. Look for supplies. Our stocks, are low, as always.

steps.name: Reunion Troops
steps.text: Yes, sir!

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: I feared you dead.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: Life underground is a sort of death. Who I am today has little to do with who I was.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: You hide, here? Less than ideal.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: Chernobog has long been uninhabitable. The Catastrophe makes little difference to that effect.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: Seems you must leave.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: The clinic has been extensively looted. We evacuated beforehand, but the loss is still substantial.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: It was only after I heard the rumors of your presence that I decided to stay here and see for myself.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: I do not deserve, such attention. It is dangerous, here.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: I wanted only to see how one of my few remaining brothers has weathered the years.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: You did not. Those ties broke. Long ago.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: Hmph...

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: ...I will find out, who did it. Your clinic. That was, an aberration.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: There is no need. At least, with you here, it is very unlikely that Reunion is responsible.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: I cannot be sure. Reunion, can be, hard to control. There are some, communication barriers.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: Still, General. You could join, Reunion.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: If Ursus was, to be liberated. Then the Infected, and the others, could live. As equals.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: Look here. Look around us. Look at this building impaled by Originium.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: I see it.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: This was once a shopping mall. All the people in a three block radius depended on this building for their very survival.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: The Catastrophe. Destroyed Chernobog. Destroyed the fortress, destroyed the city. I do not agree with, the methods. But this was, necessary. We had, no choice.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: It was not long ago that the clocktower was done up in colorful lights. Another dazzling array hung over the intersection below, bathing it in a warm glow.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: The Infected, had no right, to enjoy those lights.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: You want to make the lights glow again, and I simply want to build another market. This is the difference between us.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: ——There was a time. When you would not. Compromise like this.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: Perhaps. There may not be such a bright future at Rhodes Island, but I cannot say I feel much for this place either.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: You simply do not, wish to fight your motherland. General.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: Look at this city. Look at the Infected. Look at the mall, ruined by Originium. Look at the dead.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: And you. You have never, been afraid, to get your hands dirty.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: Correct. Should Ursus move violently against us, we will not hesitate to fight back.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: But Reunion's actions are rather outside my idea of fighting back. Look at this broken city beneath our feet——Reunion is provoking a war.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: And how many people would die in such a war? How many Ursus lives would a civil war cost?

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: Imagine it. The Ursus devouring itself. Massacring itself. Obliterating itself.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: General.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: What if, the Ursus, treated the Infected, as Ursus?

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: Then, there would be, no war.

steps.name: Reunion Soldier
steps.text: Excuse me.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Reunion Soldier
steps.text: Reporting in. The leadership has made a statement: Chernobog is now completely under our control. We are broadcasting on all frequencies.

steps.name: Reunion Soldier
steps.text: The leadership has asked for a situation report from each division.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: Right. I'll take care of it.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: Sorry, General. Wait a minute.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: Does Reunion truly understand what they are doing?

steps.name: Reunion Soldier
steps.text: How am I supposed to answer you, old man?

steps.name: Reunion Soldier
steps.text: Or were you not really asking? I guess all I can say is we're following the commander.

steps.name: Reunion Soldier
steps.text: No matter what the commander does, we're behind him.

steps.name: Reunion Soldier
steps.text: If it's right, he'll do it. If it's wrong, he'll change.

steps.name: Reunion Soldier
steps.text: We believe in Talulah and we believe in the commander. We fight for the Infected. Got it?

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: General.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: Reunion has won a great victory. And yet I do not detect any joy in your voice.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: Should I be? Happy...?

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: If the Ursus will it, any city, will be flattened.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: Such an outcome, is most challenging. This battle, it confuses me. The Ursus response.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: The war has already begun. There is no turning back now.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: Perhaps. I have been foolish.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: However, if I do nothing. The chains of the Infected, will grow heavier.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: Should we lose, our conception of the struggle, we move toward annihilation.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: So you do understand the situation. You do know what you have done.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: Yes. We are, fighting for our lives.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: Then I have no further questions.

steps.name: Reunion Soldier
steps.text: Reporting in!

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: Subcity Sector 3, damage report?

steps.name: Reunion Soldier
steps.text: Yes, sir!

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: Spare me the details. Save the civilians. It is dangerous. Protect yourselves. Don't be heroes.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: Bring a caster. Use drones to scout. That's what they're for.

steps.name: Reunion Soldier
steps.text: Understood!

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: Right...

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: Where is it, you plan to go?

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: Rhodes Island

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: Ah, I see. Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: But. Reunion has just. Attacked Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Vanguard Operator
steps.text: Why you...

steps.name: Vanguard Operator
steps.text: Amiya and Dobermann, I hope they're okay...

steps.name: Vanguard Operator
steps.text: What should I do? What can I do right now...?

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: ——If they move into Chernobog at a time like this, everyone would view Rhodes Island as an enemy.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: Why would they do this?

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: Unclear. But, there is nothing I can do, to stop the conflict.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: We just had a warrior. Fighting alone. A Sarkaz mercenary.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: And, the one from, Rhodes Island, was also Sarkaz.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: The same sort of misery... There is no difference between them and Reunion.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: The masses. Fooled by the Ursus. But to us, we are compatriots.

steps.name: Vanguard Operator
steps.text: Huh? A Sarkaz... from Rhodes Island?

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: But a mercenary. Fights for fighting's sake. Rhodes Island's warrior. Has a reason to fight.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: He lost. But he shot dead, many elite troops. The new mercenary captain, was at a loss.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: And, the enemy. He led away from the ruins.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: He wanted to hide something. He did.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: In the ashes. Was this thing. Please, return it to them.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: A true warrior... with no name.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: I will.

steps.name: Vanguard Operator
steps.text: A Sarkaz... Don't tell me that was Scout protecting me...?

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: A true warrior...

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: Yes. You have said as much before.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: Go on.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: Thirty some years ago, you wanted to have a test of sorts with me.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: Now? No longer.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: My armor. You could not pierce it. It would be unfair.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: This armor is well past its prime. A far cry from the days when the Army performed regular maintenance on it.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: My armor, is Ursus. I am a, traitor to the Empire. It will deteriorate. More and more.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: And that is why you bear the name you do. When the Empire has done wrong, you stand up to her.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: I cannot say, General. I did not choose, this name.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: 'Patriot,' is war with Ursus the correct course of action?

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: Naturally. Our war, is righteous. If not, the countless sacrifices. Were in vain.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: General. We both know, the true solution.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: But they must not, die in vain. Their deaths. Must have meaning.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: But you have already risen up, against Ursus.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: What I oppose. Is the Empire. Not the land. Not the people. Not Ursus itself.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: If the Minister of Medicine. Did this. He is our enemy.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: If a conspiracy, of the legislature. We overthrow the legislature.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: If the Army, fabricated resistance. We destroy the army.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: Talulah's goals are broad. Far-reaching. Mine are localized. And specific.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: The past wars of Ursus, were just. Now, the war of the Infected, is just.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: I fight for justice. Justice, forever belongs to Ursus.

steps.name: Reunion Soldier
steps.text: Reporting in! We have arrested some Reunion operatives who engaged in undisciplined behavior during the uprising. Here are their names!

steps.name: Reunion Soldier
steps.text: There were no operatives from Teams 2, 3, or 6 among the primary instigators.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: These are but a small part.

steps.name: Reunion Soldier
steps.text: Well, I'm afraid... this was a difficult investigation.

steps.name: Reunion Soldier
steps.text: Many of our comrades despise the Chernobogians. They're hesitant to inform on each other...

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: This undisciplined behavior. They laid hands on civilians?

steps.name: Reunion Soldier
steps.text: Didn't they deserve it, after how cruel and uncaring they were?!

steps.name: Reunion Soldier
steps.text: Were it not for them, how many more Infected would have made it? Please, Commander...!

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: They laid hands on civilians?

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: Listen.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: Hang them. The instigators. Have my men, do it.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: Tell them. Mephisto. Crownslayer.

steps.name: Reunion Soldier
steps.text: ......Yes, sir.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: ...The rest, demerits.

steps.name: Reunion Soldier
steps.text: D- demerits, sir?

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: One more infraction, death. All of this, inform the leadership.

steps.name: Reunion Soldier
steps.text: Right! Yes, sir!

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: Hate. Has grown too deep.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: If we don't fight. Hate overwhelms. It will blind Ursus.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: I never imagined Reunion was so disorganized... And when you always had such high expectations for discipline. Higher than most Ursus.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: Most of them, are not soldiers. They have no training. They must be taught. In discipline, we have strength.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: As your conflict continues to intensify, neither side will be able to sue for peace. Perhaps you are right. This is the awakening Ursus needs.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: General, you could. Help us.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: I am afraid not, 'Patriot.' I will never again step into a war.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: ...Indeed. This is, a war.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: You do not, wish to fight. This, I know.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: Ursus no longer has anything for me. Time has run its course.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: I no longer feel for the country what I once did. Forgive me. The man who stands before you is nothing but a spineless coward.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: No! No. You are not.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: Would that, my son, had lived. I would not, have walked this path. I understand you.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: He... what?

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: ...He was a great man. I am sorry.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: Why apologize, General? You did nothing. I am damned.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: Oh, yes. The knife in your hand. Yes. You adopted, the daughter, of the enemy commander.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: My daughter, is older. When, next we meet. I will bring her.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: Hah. I hope they get along.

steps.name: Reunion Soldier A
steps.text: We have wounded! Get their blood types! Don't mix up the Infected and Uninfected! Quickly!

steps.name: Reunion Soldier B
steps.text: You can give Uninfected blood to the Infected!

steps.name: Reunion Soldier A
steps.text: Who's the next of kin?

steps.name: Reunion Soldier A
steps.text: Forget it, just get to safety! Britt... move it!

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: Talulah's attack, on Rhodes Island. This misunderstanding. Will be hard to, clear up.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: I do not wish, to fight you. If this cannot, be solved.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: This may go beyond what we can solve ourselves.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: ...General.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: It saddens me. That we cannot, once again, fight side by side.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: ...Listen to me, 'Patriot...'

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: I alone have never been able to decide the fate of Ursus.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: Countless generals before me have sought to become masters of the Empire's destiny, and to a man they all died miserable failures.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: Just as the many emperors have escaped the wrath of history.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: The Empire has weathered its crises and enjoyed its golden ages. The sorcerors can divine the Empire's future, the ministers can plan the outcomes of campaigns, courtiers can study the shifting Catastrophes...

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: I have never participated in any political machinations. Not in the legislature, not in the army. Never.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: They always embarrassed me with their confidence. Everyone who thought his victory certain saw his dreams shattered. Everyone who thought his survival assured is now dead.
Mama, what are we going to eat tonight?
Potatoes again? I, I don't wanna eat boiled potatoes again!
Huh? You have to go fight? Mama, you don't have to fight.
Uncle, does Mama have to go with you again? I want her to stay! I don't want Mama to go!
Uncle, please make Mama stay. When Daddy went with you, he never came back...
I don't wanna be alone again, Uncle...

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: Win or lose, a war is a war.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: And where we go, ruin follows. Only ruin.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: We are but pawns on the chessboard of war. And who cares for the pawns? Who cares to even know their names?

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: You, are correct. I, am correct. War, doesn't care, who is correct.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: Yet you persist. I persist.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: For what? 'Patriot' of Reunion, I ask you:

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: No matter what meaning your war may hold...

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: After however many years this Ursus campaign takes, when you have filled mass graves in a dozen cities, will their lives have meant anything? Will anyone remember their names?

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: Names? Mean nothing. Warriors don't think, of these things.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: You call them warriors...

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: Sometimes, these nameless people cannot articulate their reasons for joining in battle.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: Now, they have no chance to do so.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: I have grown tired of such things. I now wish only to protect those around me. At least this small thing is within my power.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: To Ursus, to the Infected,

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: This is all I can say.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: I can't blame you, General. You don't need, to face death again.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: Oripathy, will kill me, sooner or later. I am a warrior. I want my death, to have meaning.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: I am glad you have a reason to keep fighting. I truly hope you will find happiness.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: ...Hm. General. Listen.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: I'm here.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: You don't fear death. If you did, you would be, at Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: You stay. You listen. You don't fear Catastrophe.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: You want to know. Reunion's goal.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: In fact, I want to know what you plan for the Infected of Ursus.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: Then. I will, tell you.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: You are tired, of fighting. I fight, for you.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: The rights, of the Infected. You and your children. I fight to free you, all.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: You are tired, of fighting. Good. Wallow in disgust. To end war, is also good.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: My days, are numbered. I will fight, to the end.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: You truly are an Ursus.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: And this truly is a tragic war.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: It may come to pass that I never again set foot on Ursus soil.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: Listen well, Buldrokkas'tee.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: You shall not be my enemy. Ever.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: I do regret. That I never, served under you.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: General, you shall not, be my enemy. Either.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: It's late, General. My men will, get you out, of the city. Easily.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: I would not want to cause problems for you with your leadership.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: You won't. General.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: She does not care.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: Splendid. Then I accept.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: General!

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: I hope... I pray...

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: That you find yourself. A true home, for yourself.

steps.name: Vanguard Operator
steps.text: Scout... why did you do this for me?

steps.name: Vanguard Operator
steps.text: I'm garbage! Why did you think I'm worth saving...?!

steps.name: Vanguard Operator
steps.text: What am I even doing? I just got a bunch of great intel off Reunion, but who am I supposed to give it to?

steps.name: Vanguard Operator
steps.text: Maybe we got them all wrong? I guess if we could clear up this misunderstanding, maybe we wouldn't have to...

steps.name: Vanguard Operator
steps.text: Oh right... this paper. Were there any orders written on it?

steps.name: Vanguard Operator
steps.text: I can do it, Scout... anything you tell me to do...

steps.name: Vanguard Operator
steps.text: I won't let the boss down...!

steps.name: Scout
steps.text: I have a humble request, if I might be so bold. As recompense, I took the liberty of treating your wounds. You are, for the time being, out of mortal danger.

steps.name: Scout
steps.text: So I ask that you entertain my frivolous trifles.

steps.name: Scout
steps.text: My objective for this operation is to rescue the Doctor. Amiya is quite insistent on this matter. She cannot be persuaded otherwise.

steps.name: Scout
steps.text: Ace and Amiya are of one mind. They firmly believe that only by rescuing the Doctor can Rhodes Island break this deadlock.

steps.name: Scout
steps.text: Assuming the good Doctor retains the same mental faculties as before, Rhodes Island might well be looking at a golden age.

steps.name: Scout
steps.text: But weak as I am, I am uncertain...

steps.name: Scout
steps.text: I am not certain I have the fortitude to undertake such a golden age.

steps.name: Vanguard Operator
steps.text: What...? What does that mean?

steps.name: Scout
steps.text: Over the past three years, I have suffered many losses, and bid farewell to those like unto my own flesh and blood.

steps.name: Scout
steps.text: I always believed that as long as one of us lived on, we could someday be reunited. In this spirit I have served Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Scout
steps.text: But having lost so much, now I see that even a perpetual pessimist like Misery seeks to bring back the Doctor.

steps.name: Scout
steps.text: He believes with every fiber of his being that we are destined for a future of endless victories, that we shall put death and loss behind us.

steps.name: Scout
steps.text: I do not share this belief.

steps.name: Scout
steps.text: It is not that I doubt the Doctor's skill. The Doctor can indeed tip the scales. Without the Doctor, Kazdel would be dust in the wind.

steps.name: Scout
steps.text: In fact, it was the Doctor who taught me what it means to fight.

steps.name: Scout
steps.text: And yet... With the Doctor commanding us... looking into the Doctor's eyes, one sees only victory.

steps.name: Scout
steps.text: Nothing but victory. I see nothing, save victory.

steps.name: Scout
steps.text: Nothing else in those eyes.

steps.name: Scout
steps.text: And so I am left thinking: the truth that Kal'tsit is so unwilling to reveal, does it have to do with the Doctor?

steps.name: Scout
steps.text: In these three years, why must we draw more and more crosses onto the photos of our friends? Why do these sacrifices grow more and more frequent? Why do we fight without understanding the fundamental goals of our organization?

steps.name: Scout
steps.text: I dare not speculate. I cannot speculate.

steps.name: Scout
steps.text: If the Doctor must be forged in the crucible of war, then we force this professor to transform from an educator and a researcher into a war machine...

steps.name: Scout
steps.text: And as such, it would be a truly grave mistake for us to ask Dr. {@nickname} to march into battle.

steps.name: Scout
steps.text: The Doctor should not command even one more battle. For Rhodes Island's sake, and for the Doctor's own sake.

steps.name: Scout
steps.text: ...Forgive my naiveté.

steps.name: Scout
steps.text: I recognize that my ideas are rather juvenile... and have therefore thus far been unwilling to disclose them.

steps.name: Scout
steps.text: I can only imagine how the others would laugh at me. I do not like being laughed at. And I had planned to carry these thoughts with me to my grave.

steps.name: Scout
steps.text: But then it came down to this. And I found the hope that someone might join me in taking up this idea...

steps.name: Scout
steps.text: I want the Doctor to begin anew.

steps.name: Scout
steps.text: If the Doctor could live without any connection to Rhodes Island, if the Doctor could stand again, having no memory of these preceding events...

steps.name: Scout
steps.text: If the Doctor could avoid walking once more the path of war, then all would be well.

steps.name: Scout
steps.text: I bear only this unrealistic hope

steps.name: Scout
steps.text: Forgive my verbosity. If you have no interest, then simply forget these words altogether.

steps.name: Scout
steps.text: Right. There are three things you may not forget.

steps.name: Scout
steps.text: First: Say to Dr. {@nickname} the following,

steps.name: Scout
steps.text: 'I will never forget fighting side by side with you, Doctor.'

steps.name: Scout
steps.text: Second: my squad.

steps.name: Scout
steps.text: Slink, Pter, Scorpion, Leafa, Milim, Tipsy, Slanna, Mimi, Mary, Thumbtack, Mudflower, and Macron.

steps.name: Scout
steps.text: My squad, twelve of them.

steps.name: Scout
steps.text: They broke through the enemy lines and held off their reinforcements. Were it not for them, I would never have been able to neutralize their mercenary commander.

steps.name: Scout
steps.text: However, we lost all twelve of these exemplary operators in the course of their duties.

steps.name: Scout
steps.text: I beg you, bear witness to their actions.

steps.name: Scout
steps.text: Should one ask, you must tell them for me:

steps.name: Scout
steps.text: While no one will remember the names of my squadmates, they must remember that they died with honor. They did not shrink in the face of death.

steps.name: Scout
steps.text: Of course, I know many have given their lives in service of the project that is Rhodes Island. No one's death is unique.

steps.name: Scout
steps.text: We do not fight for any one individual life. To do so would dishonor their deaths.

steps.name: Scout
steps.text: Tell the one who asks: they gave their lives for what they believed in.

steps.name: Scout
steps.text: Finally:

steps.name: Scout
steps.text: You must go on living for yourself. My Rhodes Island brother whose name I do not know, I have said so much to you, not that you should go off and die.

steps.name: Scout
steps.text: Life is precious. You must live to pursue that bright future.

steps.name: Scout
steps.text: That is all, my brother.

steps.name: Scout
steps.text: Treasure your life.

steps.name: Vanguard Operator
steps.text: Why...

steps.name: Vanguard Operator
steps.text: The Doctor... Rhodes Island...

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: Warrior!

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: You can hear, my voice.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: You have a chance, to escape. Wait, until nightfall.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: Head south. Avoid the light. You have one chance. Tonight.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: There are many, in Chernobog, who need help. You can, see them.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: The choice. Is yours.

steps.name: Vanguard Operator
steps.text: Boss, Scout, our brothers...

steps.name: Vanguard Operator
steps.text: I'll do it.
